turret.name: Sentinel
turret.description: Stays still. Fires a rotating beam up to 3 tiles.

patroller.name: Warden
patroller.description: Patrols horizontally. Strikes the four adjacent tiles.

chaser.name: Seeker
chaser.description: Steps toward the nearest explorer. Strikes adjacent tiles.

warden_elite.name: Chrono Warden
warden_elite.description: Charges for two rounds, then strikes a wide cross. Enrages below half HP.

bomber.name: Cinder Bomber
bomber.description: Stays still. Marks a tile, then leaves embers for three rounds. Embers hurt only on entry.

chaser_elite.name: Eclipse Seeker
chaser_elite.description: A double-HP Seeker. Charges for two full rounds before its fixed attack and move.
